title: kbmon_otel --check-rules misses a kbmon_ name inside a YAML-quoted expr or a __name__ matcher and misreads a recording-rule name
goal: --check-rules reads a kbmon_ metric name inside a single-quoted YAML expression; --check-rules reads a kbmon_ metric name inside a double-quoted YAML expression; --check-rules reads a kbmon_ name inside a {__name__="..."} matcher; --check-rules reads a recording-rule name with a colon (kbmon_foo:rate5m) as one name, so it neither passes a rules file that uses an unserved name nor fails one that uses only served names

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile; q, dq = chr(39), chr(34); d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); p = os.path.join(d, 'q.rules.yml'); open(p, 'w').write('groups:
- name: t
  rules:
  - alert: X
    expr: ' + q + 'kbmon_no_such_metric{a=' + dq + 'b' + dq + '} > 0' + q + '
  - alert: Y
    expr: kbmon_alerts > 0
'); r = subprocess.run(['uv', 'run', '--frozen', '--project', 'otel', 'python', 'otel/kbmon_otel.py', '--check-rules', p], capture_output=True, text=True); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 1 and 'kbmon_no_such_metric' in r.stdout + r.stderr else 1)

import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;q,dq=chr(39),chr(34);L=['groups:','- name: t','  rules:','  - alert: X','    expr: '+dq+'kbmon_no_such_metric{a='+q+'b'+q+'} > 0'+dq,'  - alert: Y','    expr: kbmon_alerts > 0'];p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'q.rules.yml');open(p,'w').write(chr(10).join(L)+chr(10));r=subprocess.run(['uv','run','--frozen','--project','otel','python','otel/kbmon_otel.py','--check-rules',p],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==1 and 'kbmon_no_such_metric' in r.stdout+r.stderr else 1)

import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;dq=chr(34);L=['groups:','- name: t','  rules:','  - alert: X','    expr: sum({__name__='+dq+'kbmon_no_such_metric'+dq+'}) > 0','  - alert: Y','    expr: kbmon_alerts > 0'];p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'n.rules.yml');open(p,'w').write(chr(10).join(L)+chr(10));r=subprocess.run(['uv','run','--frozen','--project','otel','python','otel/kbmon_otel.py','--check-rules',p],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==1 and 'kbmon_no_such_metric' in r.stdout+r.stderr else 1)

import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;L=['groups:','- name: t','  rules:','  - record: kbmon_zzz:rate5m','    expr: rate(kbmon_alerts[5m])','  - alert: Y','    expr: kbmon_zzz:rate5m > 0'];p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'r.rules.yml');open(p,'w').write(chr(10).join(L)+chr(10));r=subprocess.run(['uv','run','--frozen','--project','otel','python','otel/kbmon_otel.py','--check-rules',p],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.returncode,r.stdout[-200:],r.stderr[-200:]);sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 else 1)

clauses.clause: --check-rules reads a kbmon_ metric name inside a single-quoted YAML expression
--check-rules reads a kbmon_ metric name inside a double-quoted YAML expression
--check-rules reads a kbmon_ name inside a {__name__="..."} matcher
--check-rules reads a recording-rule name with a colon (kbmon_foo:rate5m) as one name, so it neither passes a rules file that uses an unserved name nor fails one that uses only served names

notes: Review of SP-4f4m3noq (2026-10-22): otel_prom.rule_exprs/rule_names blank a whole YAML-quoted expression with the quote stripper (a file of only quoted exprs exits 2 'no kbmon_ metric'), miss {__name__="kbmon_x"} (false pass) and read kbmon_foo:rate5m as kbmon_foo (false fail). Multi-line | blocks, inline comments and a commented-out expr are read right. The shipped rules file is plain, so nothing fails today. The reviewer recommends changing the provisional answer of ST-6oidkcqv g1 this way, and keeping the line scan otherwise.
